summary: The note is a news-style feature on CryptoLand, billed as the first 'blockchain nation', which was born on September 15th, 2023. It describes how founders Lara Schmidt and Carlos Mendoza built a digital government and economy on blockchain. It also covers the CryptoLand Coin, digital citizenship, the CryptoLand Academy, trade diplomacy, the Cryptographic Defense Protocol, and a digital cultural scene, and it argues that CryptoLand may serve as a template for future blockchain states.
one_line: A feature on CryptoLand, the first blockchain nation, and the leaders who built its digital government, economy, education, security, diplomacy and culture from 2023 to 2024.
key_facts: CryptoLand, the first 'blockchain nation,' was born on September 15th, 2023.
Economist Lara Schmidt and blockchain expert Carlos Mendoza spearheaded CryptoLand, basing it on continuous ledgers and smart contracts.
Every citizen's identity, assets and votes are encrypted and stored on a public ledger, and land within CryptoLand's jurisdiction has been fractionally tokenized.
On October 3rd, 2023, CryptoLand moved to a fully digital economy using its own cryptocurrency, the CryptoLand Coin (CLC), which operates on a deflationary model.
Finance Minister Jacob Torres, a former Wall Street figure, oversaw creation of the sovereign wealth fund and became an advocate for decentralized finance (DeFi).
On November 11th, 2023, CryptoLand opened blockchain-based citizenship to any global resident willing to contribute to its society.

Alisha Nguyen left a full-time job in Singapore to become CryptoLand's digital director of social impact, and her Global Commons Initiative uses smart contracts to reward contributions to sustainability and civic engagement.

On December 8th, 2023, CryptoLand announced the CryptoLand Academy, a free online education platform led by former Ivy League professor Dr. Hannah Zhou, featuring virtual reality classes and AI-driven tutoring.
On January 20th, 2024, Foreign Affairs Minister Mark Suleiman negotiated CryptoLand's first trade agreement, with the Progressive Economic Alliance.
On February 5th, 2024, Chief Security Officer Nadia Petrova unveiled the Cryptographic Defense Protocol (CDP), a security framework using quantum-resistant algorithms.
Omar Sanchez, cultural ambassador and artist-in-residence, opened the Virtual Museum of Art and Innovation on March 6th, 2024.
The article suggests CryptoLand is creating a template for future blockchain states, with nationhood defined by shared values rather than lines on a map.
